input_manifest_edit: 42 original local path labels replaced with local-source labels. Two historical context files have ten local prefixes shortened in total; their manifest digests and byte counts reflect those path-only edits. Original run receipts retain their original manifest and input hashes.
historical_review_receipt: review-receipt.json retains its original local status and paths relative to the original workspace. Publication and fresh build evidence are separate.
reproduction_scope: Original runner, analyzer, plotter and 42 frozen inputs are included. Re-execution is optional and is not performed by the Lean workflow. New executions have their own receipts; publication does not relabel them as the historical run.
